mentions.description: A writing platform for drafting articles with built-in grammar checking and AI-based refactoring with custom styles, featuring an improved copy/paste mechanism for moving content to other platforms like Medium and Substack.
mentions.audience: Writers publishing articles to platforms like Medium and Substack
mentions.source_excerpt: I just launched Writtte yesterday, a writing platform for drafting articles with built-in grammar checking and AI-based refactoring with custom styles, and for the first time, with a better copy/paste mechanism for other platforms like Medium, and Substack :D
